body.label: Effect
body.html: Choose one ally within 5 units. It may immediately make a Basic Attack by committing its own dice normally.

surges.html: Choose a second eligible ally within 2 units of the first to receive the card's non-damage effect.

rider.title: ORDER — AUTHORITY
rider.html: Spend this card's Authority when an ally attacks: 1–3 ignore 1 cover Defense; 4–5 ignore 1 Defense; 6+ ignore 1 Defense and gain 1 free Surge.
rider.meta: STORE ONE ROLLED RESULT; THAT RESULT IS REMOVED FROM THIS ACTION
